strings.zh: 你是从哪里来的？{SCROLL}诶？真新镇？{SCROLL}那里好像是……{NEWLINE}大木博士和联盟冠军居住的镇子吧？{CLEAR}从这么遥远的地方来的啊！
strings.en: Where did you say you’re from?{SCROLL}Huh? Pallet Town?{SCROLL}Isn’t that the town where Prof. Oak{NEWLINE}and the League Champion live? You’ve{CLEAR}come a long way to get here!
strings.notes: Hack changed the US line: zh 真新镇/大木博士和联盟冠军 (Pallet Town, Prof. Oak and the Champion); retranslated.; ext-review RV-019

strings.zh: 看你经常出门旅行的样子,{NEWLINE}旅途中应该收集了不少道具吧？{CLEAR}但是背包的容量其实是有限的哦,{CLEAR}如果哪种道具收集了上千个的话,{CLEAR}背包很可能就装不下了,{CLEAR}到那时候一定要记得清理背包。
strings.en: You look like someone who travels{NEWLINE}a lot. You must have picked up{CLEAR}plenty of items on the road.{SCROLL}But your Bag’s space is{NEWLINE}actually limited. If you collect{CLEAR}a thousand or more of one{CLEAR}item, it might not fit anymore.{SCROLL}When that happens, be sure{NEWLINE}to clear out your Bag.

strings.zh: 您希望暴走族去水都吗？
strings.en: Do you want the bikers{NEWLINE}to go to Alto Mare?
strings.notes: Toggle for the Alto Mare Bikers event (暴走族 → bikers; cf. the Alto Mare Bikers).

strings.zh: 现在暴走族是去水都的状态了。
strings.en: The bikers are now set{NEWLINE}to go to Alto Mare.

strings.zh: 现在暴走族没有去水都。
strings.en: The bikers are now{NEWLINE}not going to Alto Mare.
